item.description: Four Buckeyes have taken the first step toward being named consensus All-Americans. item.title: Ohio State Safety Caleb Downs Wins the Jim Thorpe Award As College Football’s Best Defensive Back
item.description: Caleb Downs is the best defensive back in college football. During ESPN's College Football Awards show on Friday, the Ohio State safety won the Jim Thorpe Award, given annually to the nation's top defensive back by the Oklahoma Sports Hall of Fame. Downs was crowned the winner over two fellow finalists, LSU cornerback Mansoor Delane and Notre Dame cornerback Leonard Moore.
